**Identification:** The 341-aa sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt entry **A1BEM6**, annotated as **QueA (S-adenosylmethionine:tRNA ribosyltransferase-isomerase; EC 2.4.99.17)**.

**Catalytic activity:** QueA modifies tRNA at position 34, converting **preQ₁** (7-aminomethyl-7-carbaguanosine) into **epoxyqueuosine (oQ)**. It transfers and isomerizes the ribose moiety from S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAM) onto the tRNA-bound precursor.

**Reaction:**

`preQ₁(34)-tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine → epoxyqueuosine(34)-tRNA + adenine + L-methionine + 2 H⁺`

QueA participates in **tRNA modification and queuosine biosynthesis**. This assignment is supported by an exact sequence match to a reviewed reference, rather than homology alone.
